children.name: Theora mesopotamica
children.description: Theora mesopotamica is a species of saltwater and brackish water clam, a bivalve mollusk in the family Semelidae.

children.name: Abra aequalis
children.description: Abra aequalis, also known as the Atlantic abra, is a species of marine bivalve found in the west Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Abra alba
children.description: Abra alba, or the white furrow shell, is a species of bivalve mollusc in the family Semelidae.

children.name: Abra prismatica

children.description: Scrobicularia plana, the peppery furrow shell, is a bivalve mollusc belonging to the family Semelidae.
